evidence: Workbook row 53 (both sheets): 'The task reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and isn't a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling.' Skill quality-checks.md:212-214: compare against sibling names/concepts; defect = same flows, same criteria, renamed entities. Authored for this product: instruction.md is a first-person recruiting-team request ('Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day?', 'I often move several candidates together', 'If a message arrives while I am reading further up, leave my place alone'); hireops_rules.md gives HireOps-specific rules with user reasons (one-step stage moves, rejected-from stage and reopen, Interview places 1-50, per-card version with 409 naming who changed it, optimistic move with put-back and focus retention, bulk all-or-none in board order, undo invalidated by any later touch, 30-message paging with anchored scroll, per-person unread/seen semantics, per-user per-conversation drafts surviving session expiry, candidate wording table and redaction). Seed/accounts (@hireops.example, @candidates.example, Hireops!2026), app_context and all 18 criteria (hro_intake_restart, hro_moves, hro_two_people, hro_interview_places, hro_bulk, hro_undo_activity, hro_manager_roles, hro_readonly_roles, hro_messaging, hro_long_thread, hro_unread_seen, hro_candidate, hro_pol_live_board/live_thread/earlier_place/failed_send/session_resume, hro_vis_*, gates hro_gate_render/hro_gate_shared) describe this product only. grep of the frozen task (excluding JSON) for pellmoor|colderwater|bazaar|threadline|torquebay|docketlight|boardloom|ridgeline|gridforge|patchpad|vacancy|change_me|todo returned nothing; template CHANGE_ME fields are all replaced (task.toml name turing/hireops-recruiting-operations, arena_slice recruiting-hiring-operations, own description/provenance). Closest sibling, projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (same recruiting domain): shares only generic domain facts (stage order applied..hired, no skipping, no duplicate person per job, stale writes refused, a capacity limit). Its core flows are interview panels, 1-5 panel scores, assessment-version freshness, offer/hire opening reservations, a d3 history-derived funnel, retry replay and simultaneous-commit-at-most-once (criteria e.g. offer_requires_a_complete_independent_panel, exact_derived_funnel, successful_retry_replays_one_result). HireOps has none of these; its core is a shared ordered kanban with live 15-second sync that preserves focus/scroll/drafts, bulk move plus guarded undo, optimistic put-back, and staff-candidate conversations with paging, unread/seen and candidate-side redaction. Pellmoor capacity is offer openings; HireOps capacity is Interview places with re-order and undo interactions. Criteria sets do not map one-to-one under renaming. Second closest, threadline-chat: Slack-style channels/threads/reactions/mentions; HireOps conversations are one-per-application between staff and candidate with role-scoped participation and seen receipts, so unread counts are a shared generic concept, not a clone. Domain plan: no explicit suite domain-plan document exists in the workspace beyond NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:197-203 (reuse infrastructure, author distinct domain behaviour, no nouns-swapped clones); provenance says the HireOps task was supplied, i.e. the domain is the user's assignment, and its arena_slice is distinct from every sibling's. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 12 (notes reading like an acceptance checklist) bears on 'reads as authored' - the brief and rules stay in requester voice with reasons and do not mirror criterion ids; the residual question of whether some rules paragraphs over-mirror criteria belongs to rows 1/2, not a cloning defect. Lessons 1-11 and 13-21 concern hidden requirements, weights, judge mechanics and process and do not bear on distinctness. Counterexample attempts: a broken app passing or a conforming app failing is not a mechanism of this task-level row; no sibling exists whose flows and criteria this task reproduces with renamed entities, so no clone counterexample was found. This is a source-only judgment; no runtime evidence is required for this row and none was invented.
notes: Minor observation, not a row-53 defect: arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' omits the stack prefix most siblings use (e.g. full-stack-node-express-sqlite-...); harmless for distinctness. Workspace has an older recruiting sibling (pellmoor-job-pipeline) in the same domain; if the suite plan limits one task per domain, the owner should confirm with the lead, but no such limit is documented in the read sources.
